description: Apply edits in order as ONE change, each with exactly one key: parts, connections, instances, pages, text, pours and holes (see each key). add_drawing, set_drawing, remove_drawing, add_page, rename_page, remove_page, wire_corners, rename_parts, rename_port, sheet_size, set_pour, set_hole: guide { topic: "writing-circuits" }. One refused edit writes nothing; the answer names it. The answer names the texts, pours and holes written.

add_hole.description: A non-plated mounting hole: no copper, no net

add_pour.description: Copper of a net on one layer; it fills round other nets' copper on every build, and what it joins counts as routed: check the pads the answer gives

add_text.description: No layer: a note on a schematic page (default Main) at (x, y) sheet units; layer: board silkscreen at (x, y) mm, height default 1.5

disconnect.description: A schematic trace, in either direction

part.description: A library part id (list_parts) or a built-in kind (guide { topic: "writing-circuits" })

remove_hole.description: Locked holes are refused; one inside an instance ("PS1/hole:1") lives in its sheet file

remove_part.description: With every trace connected to it

remove_pour.description: Locked pours are refused; one inside an instance ("PS1/copperpour:1") lives in its sheet file

props.description: Literal props (pcbX, pcbY, pcbRotation, schX, resistance, footprint, …); missing ones are added. schNameAt, schValueAt, pcbNameAt: label offsets { x, y }; noConnect: "pin3,pin10" flags pins meant to stay open; supplierPartNumbers: "jlcpcb:C25804". null removes these.

name: edit_circuit
